name: Full manual fielding: a stop chance on every single, two or three the computer scores (not only ground shots)
message: In Full manual fielding you now get a stop chance on every ball the computer scores 1, 2 or 3 runs off (except edges), including pushes, blocks and lofted shots that landed safe.
